messages:
Marco: Heads up — planning a cross-team sync to land a small set of continuous-batching signals into Console. Need runtime + infra inputs. TL;DR: batch size distribution histograms, per-route wait-time percentiles, and instance saturation indicators.
Anya: +1. From runtime side we can emit batch_size histogram and per-batch wait_ms histogram. low overhead if we expose as p50/p90/p99 + a raw histogram with 10ms buckets.
Priya: For infra we can add queue fill_rate and active_workers per pool, and a backpressure counter when dispatcher drops/defers.
Marco: Great. Also want per-model tag + route + hw_tier on every metric so Console can group and filter.
Jin: Question: do we want these as metrics or as telemetry events? Metrics for dashboards, events for tracing. My vote: metrics (Prom-style) with labels for live dashboards + occasional events for sample traces.
Devon: UX asks: can we show batch size distribution as an interactive violin or histogram with overlays of target quantiles? Need an alert when median wait_time > 30ms for >5m.
Olga: Console note — prefer a compact card with sparkline + p90 number and an expandable histogram modal. Also want annotation when rollout/policy change happened.
Marco: Agree on alert. Let's define concrete names and label set. Proposed metric names: 
```
redwood_batch.size_histogram
redwood_batch.wait_ms_histogram
redwood_queue.fill_rate
redwood_pool.active_workers
redwood_dispatch.backpressure_count_total
```
Labels: model, route, hw_tier, customer_tier, region, deployment_id
Priya: infra will emit redwood_queue.* and redwood_pool.*. We'll attach deployment_id and region automatically. Ok with including model/route? We might not know model at infra layer on prem. Maybe make model,route optional labels.
Anya: Runtime will emit batch metrics and include model and route. For private deployments where runtime doesn't surface model, we'll omit label — dashboards should treat missing as "unknown".
Jin: For histograms please use the Prom histogram type so we can derive quantiles and aggregate across instances. Avoid sending huge cardinality label values.
Marco: Noted. Let's cap customer_tier to small set: free, paid, enterprise. No user-level ids.
Devon: Can someone add a small panel prototype in grafana? I can wire it into Console later. Need sample queries.
Anya: I'll drop sample PromQLs: 
```
# p90 wait per route
histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(redwood_batch.wait_ms_histogram_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
# batch size distribution (avg)
sum(rate(redwood_batch.size_histogram_sum[5m]))/sum(rate(redwood_batch.size_histogram_count[5m])) by (route)
# fill rate per pool
avg(redwood_queue.fill_rate) by (deployment_id)
```
Priya: infra will also emit a boolean gauge redwood_pool.saturated{deployment_id} when cpu/gpu_util > 90% and queue length > X. That would help correlate latency spikes.
SRE-bot: Incident digest: last 24h spike correlated with pool:south-1 saturated. See #incidents/1801999000.
Marco: Good signal. Action items: 1) Anya to add batch histograms PR -> runtime repo (due EOD Thu). 2) Priya to add queue + saturation metrics PR -> infra metrics (due Mon). 3) Jin to add Prom scrape + recording rules proposal -> telemetry repo (due Mon). 4) Olga & Devon to mock Console card + grafana panels (wireframes by Mon).
Anya: I'm on it. PR will include histogram buckets: [0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256] for size and 5ms buckets up to 500ms for wait.
Priya: For saturation threshold let's use gpu_util > 90% && queue_len > 200 for now. I'll annotate in PR.
Jin: Will add recording rules for p50/p90/p99 and a pre-aggregated "batch_fill_rate" for Console to pull.
Devon: Can you also expose a per-route "fallback_rate" when smart-routing switches to cheaper model? Need to correlate rollouts.
Marco: Yes add redwood_routing.fallback_count_total{route,from_model,to_model}. Don't include user ids.
Olga: UX question: annotate rollouts — can the recording rule include tags for rollout_id? If not, we can ingest rollout events into Console and match by window.
Jin: Rollout_id will be emitted as an event (not metric) and Console can join on time windows. Recording rules shouldn't include high-cardinality rollout_id.
Priya: One more: please include a "sampled_trace_id" label on a small percent of batches so we can pull full trace when investigating. Runtime can sample 0.1%.
Marco: Perfect. Let's keep the first PRs small. If everyone agrees I'll open a meta issue linking runtime/infra/telemetry/console tasks.
Anya: Agree. I'll open runtime PR and link the issue.
Devon: I'll create the grafana board skeleton and add the mockups to the issue.
Olga: I'll prepare the Console card spec with expand modal and alert thresholds.
Marco: Thanks all — follow-ups in the issue. @here if anyone else wants in. :thumbsup:
